title: cyrtomium pachyphyllum
intro: Cyrtomium pachyphyllum, commonly known as the Chinese ladder fern, is a species of fern that is native to East Asia. It is known for its potential health benefits, including lowering blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyrtomium pachyphyllum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and polysaccharides, and have been reported to exhibit immunomodulatory and anti-cancer activities. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Cyrtomium pachyphyllum for medicinal use.
